scenarios.name: RETIRED – Bull – OpenAI MRA Delivers, Wafer-Scale Decode Wins
scenarios.notes: OpenAI 750MW deploys on schedule and the 1.25GW option is exercised; AWS Bedrock ramp + AMD disaggregation make Cerebras the default fast-decode layer; RPO ($25.4B) converts on schedule. Revenue ~$9B by 2031 at ~25% core net margin -> EPS ~$8; 40x exit for the category-defining inference franchise.

scenarios.name: RETIRED – Base – Committed Capacity Delivers, Optionality Lapses
scenarios.notes: The committed 750MW OpenAI tranches and initial AWS lease deliver; the 2GW option lapses; inference pricing erodes as GPU decode improves. Revenue ~$4.5B by 2031 at ~18% core net margin -> EPS ~$3.3; 30x exit as growth normalizes post-2028.

scenarios.name: RETIRED – Bear – OpenAI Entanglement Breaks / Decode Reverts to GPU
scenarios.notes: SemiAnalysis thesis confirmed: OpenAI shifts future decode to Nvidia GPUs; an MRA tranche miss triggers termination rights and WC-loan acceleration; RPO impairs. Fixed-cost data-center leases (~$2.25B signed, not commenced) bite; revenue stalls near $1.5B; re-rating to a sub-scale hardware multiple. EPS ~$0.6 by 2031.

evidence_for: RPO $25.4B at 2026-06-30 (vs $24.6B at 2025-12-31), majority attributable to the OpenAI MRA; ~22% recognizable within 24 months [10-Q 2026-08-12; confirm pass 80%].
OpenAI MRA (signed Dec 2025): 750MW committed 2026-2028, option to 2.0GW by 2030; 'valued at more than $20 billion' [S-1 2026-04-17, verbatim-confirmed].

AWS Commercial Agreement June 2026: first hyperscaler deployment, multi-year lease, exclusivity and capacity guarantees; disaggregated inference partitioning workloads across Trainium3 and CS-3 (no prefill/decode role split stated in filings); Bedrock integration targeted Q1 2027 (press/IR-only, not in filings). AWS warrant: 2,696,678 Class N @ $100.00, 10% (269,668 sh, ~$50.0M FV) vested at issuance, 90% vest on AWS aggregate payment thresholds within 5 years [10-Q s_0006_c05; Note 12 raw; Q1/Q2 2026 releases].
Revenue $510.0M FY2025 (+76%); Q2 2026 $180.1M (+74% YoY); FY2026 core revenue guide raised to $880-890M; CFO plans to 'more than triple revenue in 2027' [S-1; 10-Q; Q2'26 release].
Core (non-GAAP) net loss only $(6.9)M in Q2 2026 / $(9.4)M H1 — near breakeven ex-IPO SBC and warrant amortization [10-Q s_0002_c17/19].
Liquidity: $7.4B cash+restricted + $1.2B securities + undrawn $850M revolver at 2026-06-30 [10-Q; confirm pass 80%].
Supply-chain wedge: 'We do not use HBM memory, CoWoS packaging or 3nm fabrication technology, all of which are currently supply limited' [Q2'26 release, verbatim].

Demand-side scaling evidence: core cloud revenue +287% YoY (Q2'26); >600MW data-center capacity live or under contract for delivery by end-2027; manufacturing capacity scaling >10x in 2026 via new Flex/Sanmina/Rocket EMS lines; TSMC wafer supply secured [Q2'26 earnings release, primary].

Bounded physical-reliability evidence: Feldman cites TSMC 105C/10-year qualification, CS-3 junction temperatures <65C average/<=85C maximum, Arrhenius estimates of 33 years at 85C, and <0.5% deployed-wafer decommissioning to rebut Culper's ~2-year physical-life claim. These remain issuer assertions without independent qualification or age-cohort fleet data; they do not establish pricing power, utilization, ROIC, OpenAI decode share, or MRA execution [Cerebras CEO blog 2026-11-05; findings ad06a57b].

Q3 2026 core revenue $230.873M beat the $214-216M guide; core cloud $144.914M (+272% YoY), core GM 41.0%; Q4 core guide $310-330M / 47-49% GM and FY2026 core guide raised to $940-960M / 42-44% GM [Q3 Exhibit 99.1, direct confirm; findings 6fa19047].

Q3 2026 RPO $26.1B (33% first 24 months / 44% months 25-48 / remainder thereafter); OpenAI arrangement revenue $72.4M; liquidity $7.804820B including restricted cash plus undrawn $850M revolver. These positives do not establish delivery, utilization, or cash returns and do not revive the closed thesis [Q3 10-Q; adapter 80%; arithmetic liquidity total].
evidence_against: Concentration: Q2 2026 Customer A 34% / B 32% / C 10% (A = MBZUAI by AR cross-reference; B matches OpenAI MRA revenue magnitude); two customers = 76% of receivables [10-Q s_0001_c06/07].

OpenAI entanglement: OpenAI is anchor customer + $918.2M lender (6% WC loan, accelerates if MRA terminated other than for OpenAI breach) + warrant holder (up to 33.4M Class N shares @ $0.00001; 10.0M exercised Jul 2026) [10-Q s_0001_c07/10/20; confirm pass 80%].
SemiAnalysis report (early Oct 2026): OpenAI's future 'Ultrafast' mode to run on Nvidia GPUs, not Cerebras — attacks the RPO anchor; ~20% drawdown wk of 2026-09-28 [SECONDARY, unverified at source].
Warrant amortization is contra-revenue through October 2031 ($44.3M in Q2 2026); GAAP margins optically suppressed for years [10-Q].
Material weaknesses in ICFR; disclosure controls 'not effective' at 2026-06-30 [10-Q s_0006_c03].

Lockup overhang is staggered, not done: early releases of 6.7% of each holder's Eligible Securities on Aug 19 / Sep 2 / Sep 16 (elapsed) and 8.9% on Sep 30 / Oct 14 / Oct 28 (two windows still ahead as of 2026-10-14); up to ~171.1M shares total early-releasable incl. ~15M directors/officers; full expiry ~Nov 9 — '利空出尽' claims are premature [S-1 lock-up section, verbatim-confirmed; 424B4 via sec-api].
Insider selling: 46 Forms 4 in first 4 months post-IPO, zero open-market buys, ~1.29M shares sold $161-250 [EDGAR Forms 4/144].
~$2.25B of data-center leases signed Q2+Q3 2026 not yet commenced — fixed-cost model mismatch vs consumption-priced inference [10-Q s_0001_c19/20].

Customer-warrant economics (2026-10-23 deep dive): OpenAI 33,445,026 Class N @ $0.00001 (grant-date FV $82.02/sh; 10,033,508 vested/exercised; 23,411,518 delivery-contingent tranches deemed not probable); G42 two warrants totaling 3,513,491 @ $0.01 (~$301.8M grant value, no performance conditions, fully exercised); aggregate customer-warrant asset $1,128.4M amortizing as contra-revenue through Oct 2031 [10-Q Note 12 raw; S-1 raw; confirm pass 60% floor + direct extraction].

Cash reality H1 2026: OCF $(47.5)M, capex $(548.9)M, FCF ~$(596)M; Q2 GAAP gross margin 14% (hardware 2%, cloud 20%) vs core GP $85.217M on $209.869M core revenue (40.6%; corrected 2026-11-13); OpenAI loan repayments so far were $86.3M of non-cash service credits, zero cash [Q2 Exhibit 99.1; 10-Q cash-flow/MD&A raw].

Dilution inventory vs 112.2M Class A (Aug 5 2026): 76.0M anti-dilutive (26.1M warrants, 23.8M options, 16.5M RSUs, 9.0M PRSUs) + 25.8M unvested customer warrants + 42.7M 2026-Plan reserve + 48.9M ESPP; Class N converts 1:1 into voting Class A on transfer; founder PRSUs at $75B/$150B/$250B market-cap hurdles [10-Q cover, Note 5/12 raw; S-1 raw].

THESIS KILL 2026-11-13: Q3 10-Q says delivered OpenAI capacity was below the MRA-contemplated quantity before possible excused-delay adjustments; delays may continue through part of 2027, with credits and conditional tranche-termination mechanics. Resolves cbrs-openai-mra-intact-fy26 FALSE and fires the pre-committed kill trigger; no tranche/full-MRA termination or loan default is established [Q3 10-Q Risk Factors; adapter 80% + direct inspection; findings 6fa19047].

Q3 capital intensity: nine-month OCF $(388.894)M, capex $1,046.059M, analyst simple FCF $(1,434.953)M; signed but uncommenced data-center leases approximately $8.5B undiscounted [Q3 10-Q cash flows/Note 15; adapter 80%].

Q3 named concentration MBZUAI 38% / OpenAI 34% / G42 7%; two customers 80% of AR. OpenAI loan $829.082M after $175.489M cumulative non-cash credits, no cash payments. Disclosure controls remained ineffective but deficiencies did not result in a material misstatement [Q3 10-Q; adapter 60-80%].
open_questions: What are contemplated vs delivered, energized, customer-accepted and utilized MW by OpenAI tranche, and which delays are contractually excused?
What are final net delay credits, day-for-day term shortening, tranche cancellations and the resulting RPO bridge after the filed delivery shortfall?
Can Cerebras fund the approximately $8.5B uncommenced-lease stack and capex without adverse debt/equity terms, and when do OCF and FCF after capex turn positive?
Can AWS, Oracle and Microsoft convert agreements and milestones into disclosed revenue without preferential terms destroying margins?
Does OpenAI's future decode remain on Cerebras? The original SemiAnalysis report remains unread; the Q3 kill decision does not depend on resolving this.
Did the initial approximately 250MW delivery milestone occur in 2026? Resolve the existing prediction only from its designated FY2026 10-K or Q4 materials.
Can official Q3 supplemental materials/captions substantiate transcript-only claims about land/power/shell causation, 2H27 recovery, RPO credit deductions and cancellations?
When will disclosure-control material weaknesses be remediated and tested effectively, and what independent evidence supports fleet reliability and cash ROIC?

decision_journal.situation: CBRS at $146.62 (~$35B cap) trades 21% below its May 2026 IPO price ($185) after four selloffs (post-Q1 margins, post-Q2, SemiAnalysis Nvidia-for-Ultrafast report, lockup approach). Fundamentals are dual-sided: $25.4B RPO anchored by the >$20B OpenAI MRA plus AWS/AMD partnerships vs extreme concentration (Q2 top customers 34%/32%/10%), OpenAI as customer+lender+warrant-holder, ICFR material weaknesses, and ~171M shares unlocking ~2026-11-09. Scenario-weighted 5-year expected CAGR is ~-3.4% from this entry on a $1.00 FY2027 core-EPS base.
alternatives_rejected: Initiate a starter position at ~$147 (rejected: negative scenario-weighted expected return; the two biggest unknowns — SemiAnalysis claim and lockup supply — resolve within weeks at no cost to waiting).
Buy before the Q3 print to front-run a lockup-absorption rally (rejected: event-timing bet, not a price/probability edge; a guide miss into lockup expiry is the worst path).

Drop coverage as uninvestable concentration (rejected: backlog quality and inference-architecture evidence are worth a tracked belief state with dated predictions; the OpenAI MRA alone is a market-structure signal for the ANET/GOOG theses).

decision_journal.situation: Reviewed a third-party CBRS research piece on the GPT-6.1 Ultrafast hardware swap. Confirm pass: lockup early-release calendar (6.7% x3 Aug/Sep; 8.9% x3 Sep 30/Oct 14/Oct 28) verified verbatim against the S-1 — the 'post-Sep-30 all-clear' narrative is wrong, two windows remain; Q2'26 release verifies core cloud +287% YoY, 600MW+ contracted, >10x manufacturing expansion (Flex/Sanmina/Rocket), TSMC supply secured. Article's per-year MRA delivery schedule (250/500/750MW) NOT found in filings — logged as unverified and converted into prediction cbrs-ye2026-250mw-delivery. Price ~$149 remains >2x the $50-70 entry zone; no probability change justified by a secondary essay whose factual core we already held.
alternatives_rejected: Move scenario probabilities on the article's framing (rejected: the three-hypothesis structure sharpens the question but adds no primary fact beyond what was already in the belief state; probabilities move on the SemiAnalysis original or the Q3 print, not on commentary).
Log the 250/500/750MW schedule as contract fact (rejected: not in the 10-Q or S-1; promote only after 424B4/MRA-exhibit verification).

decision_journal.situation: Customer-economics deep dive (findings: docs/research/tickers/cerebras-customer-economics.md; confirm pass 6/6 PASS @ 0.60 floor + direct extraction from cached 10-Q/S-1 HTML). Confirmed the three-sided structure: OpenAI got >$20B contracted capacity + a 33.4M-share $0.00001 warrant (~$2.7B grant-date FV; 23.4M delivery-contingent shares deemed not probable) + collateral/acceleration rights on the $1.0B loan funding the build-out; G42 got ~$302M of immediately-vested $0.01 warrants with no performance conditions; AWS got pricing/exclusivity/capacity guarantees plus a $100-strike warrant that is 90% payment-threshold-conditional. Cerebras's side: Q2 GAAP GM 14% (hardware 2%), core GP ~47%, H1 FCF ~$(596)M, $1.13B warrant asset amortizing through Oct 2031 (Q2 suppression mostly G42-linked, not OpenAI). Public holders carry the 750MW delivery obligation (failure = MRA termination + $918M loan acceleration) and a dilution inventory of ~76M anti-dilutive + 25.8M unvested customer warrants + 91.5M plan/ESPP reserves vs 112.2M Class A. Price fell $146.62 -> $117.98 (Oct 22) -> $108.94 (Oct 23) with NO company-originated catalyst (zero SEC filings since Aug 12): Maia 300 reveal, Oct 14 lockup tranche, TD Cowen target cut to $175, pre-Nov-9 positioning. Q3 print confirmed for 2026-11-12 AMC.
alternatives_rejected: Move scenario probabilities on the ~20% price decline (rejected: the decomposition shows supply/sentiment, not new fundamental information; per the standing rule, probabilities move on the SemiAnalysis original or the Q3 print, and the SemiAnalysis claim remains only X posts with Altman neither confirming nor denying).

Treat the drop toward $108.94 as approaching the entry zone and prepare a starter (rejected: entry zone is $50-70; at $108.94 the scenario-weighted CAGR is only ~+2.5%, still far below the 12% hurdle; price falling does not by itself clear the bar).

Promote the 250/500/750MW per-year schedule to contract fact on the S-1 loan language (rejected: 'final tranche of the initial 250 MW' corroborates an initial 250MW block but does not establish the annual schedule; prediction cbrs-ye2026-250mw-delivery stands).

decision_journal.situation: Deep research on Feldman's 2026-11-05 rebuttal to Culper (findings: docs/research/tickers/cerebras-wafer-scale-rebuttal.md; committed ad06a57b). Fresh-context confirm pass verified the SEC financial, contract and accounting claims at 0.60-0.80 or by direct SEC/exhibit inspection. The CEO's temperature, Arrhenius and <0.5% decommissioning figures remain issuer assertions; Culper's original PDF was inaccessible and its secondary numerical retellings remain unverified. The response weakens a peripheral two-year physical-failure argument but does not alter the existing bear mechanism (OpenAI decode migration, MRA termination/loan acceleration and fixed costs) or establish pricing power and ROIC.
alternatives_rejected: Raise Bull probabilities or commercial assumptions because Feldman disputed two-year physical failure (rejected: physical durability, accounting useful life and economic returns are different claims; no new delivery, pricing, utilization or ROIC evidence).
Treat the Culper rebuttal as resolution of the separate SemiAnalysis Nvidia-for-decode claim (rejected: different evidence chain and falsifier; the original SemiAnalysis source remains unread).
Resolve any existing dated prediction early (rejected: none of the five resolution criteria intersects with the reliability post).

decision_journal.situation: Q3 deep research (findings docs/research/tickers/cerebras-q3-2026.md; committed 6fa19047) verified 15/15 claims in a fresh confirm pass. Core revenue $230.873M beat the $214-216M guide and FY2026 core guidance rose to $940-960M, resolving cbrs-q3-2026-core-revenue TRUE. The Q3 10-Q nevertheless discloses an OpenAI delivery shortfall before possible excused-delay adjustments, with delays potentially continuing through part of 2027 and credit/tranche-termination mechanics. That resolves cbrs-openai-mra-intact-fy26 FALSE and fires the thesis's explicit kill trigger. Nine-month simple FCF was $(1,434.953)M by analyst arithmetic and uncommenced leases reached approximately $8.5B. No tranche/full-MRA termination or loan default is asserted; official call captions/deck were not inspected and transcript-only claims remain quarantined.
alternatives_rejected: Shift Bull/Base/Bear probabilities and keep the old thesis active (rejected: its on-schedule-capacity premise is falsified; reweighting without tranche-level delivery/credit/cancellation evidence creates false precision).
Retain the $50-70 entry zone after the revenue beat (rejected: the range derives from retired scenarios; fairValueRange is now null and price alone cannot revive the thesis).
Treat the delivery disclosure as tranche termination, full-MRA termination or loan acceleration (rejected: those events were not disclosed; the kill test and contractual consequences are distinct).
Use third-party transcript explanations to override the filing (rejected: official captions/deck were unavailable, so call-only causation, recovery, credit and cancellation claims remain unverified).
